name: Tiger Rush
winType: 10 in Main Game, 25 in Bonus Game
review:
A tiger in a bamboo forest, on 10 lines in the base game and 25 in the bonus, with expanding wilds, bonus spins and expanding reels.

The jump from 10 to 25 lines is what makes the bonus worth waiting for, since the same wilds suddenly cover a lot more ground. Medium volatility, 1,783x cap, 96.3% RTP. A balanced game with a clean, simple look.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
